Dr. A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar, J.

In all these Review Petitions preferred by the State, the limited aspect that is pointed out as an error apparent on the face of the judgment is the figure of Rs.10,400/- per Cent that was arrived at by us in the impugned judgment as the market value of the lands acquired from the appellants/claimants and based on which the compensation due to them was fixed.

Referring to Annexure A in RP.No.1693/2025, which is a compilation of the details collected from the record room of the Karapuzha Irrigation Project Office and refers to LAR cases that were adjudicated in respect of the acquisition made for the said project, it is pointed out by the learned Government Pleader on behalf of the State that the market value fixed by this Court at Rs.10,400/- per Cent was a mistake and the figure ought to have been Rs.9,155/- per Cent as was awarded in LAR No.24 of 2008.

2. We have considered the said submission made on behalf of the petitioner State, and on hearing the learned counsel for the respondents/claimants, we are inclined to effect the correction of the amounts mentioned in the impugned judgment towards the market value of the lands acquired from the claimants.

Accordingly, we direct that in the impugned judgment the figure of Rs.10,400/- per Cent in paragraphs 7 and 8 of the judgment shall be substituted by the figure Rs.9,155/- per Cent,
and RP.No.1693/2025 in WA No.1524/2022 RP.No.1685/2025 in WA No.1519/2022 RP.No.1667/2025 in WA No.1369/2022 & RP.No.1739/2025 in WA No.1517/2022 10 2026:KER:20211 the portion of the sentence in paragraph 7 which reads "which is only Rs.200/-
less than what was fixed by the Lok Adalat in the award that was relied upon by the respondents."
shall stand deleted.
The Registry shall carry out the aforesaid corrections in the judgment and issue a fresh certified copy of the judgment to the parties.
The review petitions are allowed to the limited extent above.

Sd/-
DR. A.K.JAYASANKARAN NAMBIAR JUDGE Sd/-
